description: This file contains the implementation of a remote dispatcher for services in the Apache OFBiz framework, enabling remote invocation of services via RMI.

classes.name: RemoteDispatcherImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a remote dispatcher for executing services via RMI, with methods for synchronous, asynchronous, and scheduled service invocation.

methods.name: RemoteDispatcherImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the remote dispatcher with a local dispatcher and socket factories, setting exportAll based on properties.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Executes a service synchronously, checking export permissions.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Overloaded method with transaction timeout and transaction requirement parameters.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Runs a service synchronously, ignoring errors, with export check.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Runs a service asynchronously with a requester, with export check.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Overloaded versions with different parameters for async execution.

methods.name: runAsyncWait
methods.description: Runs a service asynchronously and waits for result, with export check.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules a service to run at a specified time with recurrence parameters, with export check.

methods.name: checkExportFlag
methods.description: Checks if a service is marked for export before invocation.
